description.value: Lavender Art Café is a Persian-inspired artisan café inside Nanaimo's Country Club Centre, blending Iranian culinary tradition with specialty coffee and locally sourced Vancouver Island lavender used in pastries and beverages. The café handcrafts signature tea blends — including cardamom, cinnamon, and green tea combinations — packaged in-house and unavailable elsewhere. Touring cyclists will find a warm, creative space with a broad menu spanning espresso drinks, iced beverages, Persian brunch plates, and house-baked goods.

address.value: Unit 2A – 3200 North Island Highway, Country Club Centre, Nanaimo, BC V9T 1W1

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: bollard (2 spaces) at 51m; rack at 62m; rack at 88m; bollard (2 spaces) at 89m. Total: 4 spaces.

The menu explicitly labels gluten-free items (Carrot Bar, Red Lentil Bread) and includes several vegetarian-compatible dishes. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
